reason: I'd definitely use the free first visit, and I'd probably pay for one weekday drop-in because I'm always looking for somewhere to take the kids. Once or twice a month is all I can afford, so I'd stay on single visits and not sign up for a membership.
objection: With two kids it's about $20 a visit plus gas from Fruitland, and I'd only go once or twice a month, so no membership or pack pays off for me.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper weekday price for the first child, or a 5-visit pack that doesn't expire for several months.
